Pound.flavorText: The target is physically pounded with a long tail or a foreleg, etc.
Pound.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

Karate Chop.flavorText: The target is attacked with a sharp chop. Critical hits land more easily.
Karate Chop.effect: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.

Double Slap.flavorText: The target is slapped repeatedly, back and forth, two to five times in a row.

Comet Punch.flavorText: The target is hit with a flurry of punches that strike two to five times in a row.

Mega Punch.flavorText: The target is slugged by a punch thrown with muscle-packed power.
Mega Punch.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

Pay Day.flavorText: Numerous coins are hurled at the target to inflict damage. Money is earned after the battle.
Pay Day.effect: Scatters money on the ground worth five times the user’s level.

Fire Punch.flavorText: The target is punched with a fiery fist. It may also leave the target with a burn.
Fire Punch.effect: Has a chance to burn the target.

Ice Punch.flavorText: The target is punched with an icy fist. It may also leave the target frozen.
Ice Punch.effect: Has a chance to freeze the target.

Thunder Punch.flavorText: The target is punched with an electrified fist. It may also leave the target with paralysis.
Thunder Punch.effect: Has a chance to paralyze the target.

Scratch.flavorText: Hard, pointed, and sharp claws rake the target to inflict damage.
Scratch.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

Vise Grip.flavorText: The target is gripped and squeezed from both sides to inflict damage.
Vise Grip.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

Guillotine.flavorText: A vicious, tearing attack with big pincers. The target will faint instantly if this attack hits.

Razor Wind.flavorText: A two-turn attack. Blades of wind hit opposing Pokémon on the second turn. Critical hits land more easily.
Razor Wind.effect: Requires a turn to charge before attacking.

Swords Dance.flavorText: A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit. It sharply raises the user’s Attack stat.
Swords Dance.effect: Raises the user’s Attack by two stages.

Cut.flavorText: The target is cut with a scythe or a claw. It can also be used to cut down thin trees.
Cut.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

Gust.flavorText: A gust of wind is whipped up by wings and launched at the target to inflict damage.
Gust.effect: Inflicts regular damage and can hit Pokémon in the air.

Wing Attack.flavorText: The target is struck with large, imposing wings spread wide to inflict damage.
Wing Attack.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

Whirlwind.flavorText: The target is blown away, to be replaced by another Pokémon in its party. In the wild, the battle ends.
Whirlwind.effect: Immediately ends wild battles. Forces trainers to switch Pokémon.

Fly.flavorText: The user soars, then strikes its target on the second turn. It can also be used for flying to any familiar town.
Fly.effect: User flies high into the air, dodging all attacks, and hits next turn.

Bind.flavorText: Things such as long bodies or tentacles are used to bind and squeeze the target for four to five turns.
Bind.effect: Prevents the target from fleeing and inflicts damage for 2-5 turns.

Slam.flavorText: The target is slammed with a long tail, vines, etc., to inflict damage.
Slam.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

Vine Whip.flavorText: The target is struck with slender, whiplike vines to inflict damage.
Vine Whip.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

Stomp.flavorText: The target is stomped with a big foot. It may also make the target flinch.
Stomp.effect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.

Double Kick.flavorText: The target is quickly kicked twice in succession using both feet.

Mega Kick.flavorText: The target is attacked by a kick launched with muscle-packed power.
Mega Kick.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

Jump Kick.flavorText: The user jumps up high, then strikes with a kick. If the kick misses, the user hurts itself.
Jump Kick.effect: If the user misses, it takes half the damage it would have inflicted in recoil.

Rolling Kick.flavorText: The user lashes out with a quick, spinning kick. It may also make the target flinch.
Rolling Kick.effect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.

Sand Attack.flavorText: Sand is hurled in the target’s face, reducing its accuracy.
Sand Attack.effect: Lowers the target’s accuracy by one stage.

Headbutt.flavorText: The user sticks out its head and attacks by charging straight into the target. It may also make the target flinch.
Headbutt.effect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.

Horn Attack.flavorText: The target is jabbed with a sharply pointed horn to inflict damage.
Horn Attack.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

Fury Attack.flavorText: The target is jabbed repeatedly with a horn or beak two to five times in a row.

Horn Drill.flavorText: The user stabs the target with a horn that rotates like a drill. If it hits, the target faints instantly.

Tackle.flavorText: A physical attack in which the user charges and slams into the target with its whole body.
Tackle.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

Body Slam.flavorText: The user drops onto the target with its full body weight. It may also leave the target with paralysis.
Body Slam.effect: Has a chance to paralyze the target.

Wrap.flavorText: A long body or vines are used to wrap and squeeze the target for four to five turns.
Wrap.effect: Prevents the target from fleeing and inflicts damage for 2-5 turns.

Take Down.flavorText: A reckless, full-body charge attack for slamming into the target. It also damages the user a little.
Take Down.effect: User receives 1/4 the damage it inflicts in recoil.

Thrash.flavorText: The user rampages and attacks for two to three turns. It then becomes confused, however.
Thrash.effect: Hits every turn for 2-3 turns, then confuses the user.

Double-Edge.flavorText: A reckless, life-risking tackle. It also damages the user by a fairly large amount, however.
Double-Edge.effect: User receives 1/3 the damage inflicted in recoil.

Tail Whip.flavorText: The user wags its tail cutely, making opposing Pokémon less wary and lowering their Defense stat.
Tail Whip.effect: Lowers the target’s Defense by one stage.

Poison Sting.flavorText: The user stabs the target with a poisonous stinger. This may also poison the target.
Poison Sting.effect: Has a chance to poison the target.

Twineedle.flavorText: The user damages the target twice in succession by jabbing it with two spikes. It may also poison the target.
Twineedle.effect: Hits twice in the same turn. Has a chance to poison the target.

Pin Missile.flavorText: Sharp spikes are shot at the target in rapid succession. They hit two to five times in a row.

Leer.flavorText: The opposing team gains an intimidating leer with sharp eyes. The opposing team’s Defense stats are reduced.
Leer.effect: Lowers the target’s Defense by one stage.

Bite.flavorText: The target is bitten with viciously sharp fangs. It may make the target flinch.
Bite.effect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.

Growl.flavorText: The user growls in an endearing way, making the opposing team less wary. The foes’ Attack stats are lowered.
Growl.effect: Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage.

Roar.flavorText: The target is scared off and replaced by another Pokémon in its party. In the wild, the battle ends.
Roar.effect: Immediately ends wild battles. Forces trainers to switch Pokémon.

Sing.flavorText: A soothing lullaby is sung in a calming voice that puts the target into a deep slumber.

Supersonic.flavorText: The user generates odd sound waves from its body. It may confuse the target.

Sonic Boom.flavorText: The target is hit with a destructive shock wave that always inflicts 20 HP damage.

Disable.flavorText: For four turns, this move prevents the target from using the move it last used.
Disable.effect: Disables the target’s last used move for 1-8 turns.

Acid.flavorText: The opposing team is attacked with a spray of harsh acid. The acid may also lower the targets’ Sp. Def stats.
Acid.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.

Ember.flavorText: The target is attacked with small flames. It may also leave the target with a burn.
Ember.effect: Has a chance to burn the target.

Flamethrower.flavorText: The target is scorched with an intense blast of fire. It may also leave the target with a burn.
Flamethrower.effect: Has a chance to burn the target.

Mist.flavorText: The user cloaks its body with a white mist that prevents any of its stats from being cut for five turns.
Mist.effect: Protects the user’s stats from being changed by enemy moves.

Water Gun.flavorText: The target is blasted with a forceful shot of water.
Water Gun.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

Hydro Pump.flavorText: The target is blasted by a huge volume of water launched under great pressure.
Hydro Pump.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

Surf.flavorText: It swamps the area around the user with a giant wave. It can also be used for crossing water.
Surf.effect: Inflicts regular damage and can hit Dive users.

Ice Beam.flavorText: The target is struck with an icy-cold beam of energy. It may also freeze the target solid.
Ice Beam.effect: Has a chance to freeze the target.

Blizzard.flavorText: A howling blizzard is summoned to strike the opposing team. It may also freeze them solid.
Blizzard.effect: Has a chance to freeze the target.

Psybeam.flavorText: The target is attacked with a peculiar ray. It may also cause confusion.
Psybeam.effect: Has a chance to confuse the target.

Bubble Beam.flavorText: A spray of bubbles is forcefully ejected at the opposing team. It may also lower their Speed stats.
Bubble Beam.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.

Aurora Beam.flavorText: The target is hit with a rainbow-colored beam. This may also lower the target’s Attack stat.
Aurora Beam.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Attack by one stage.

Hyper Beam.flavorText: The target is attacked with a powerful beam. The user must rest on the next turn to regain its energy.
Hyper Beam.effect: User foregoes its next turn to recharge.

Peck.flavorText: The target is jabbed with a sharply pointed beak or horn.
Peck.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

Drill Peck.flavorText: A corkscrewing attack with the sharp beak acting as a drill.
Drill Peck.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

Submission.flavorText: The user grabs the target and recklessly dives for the ground. It also hurts the user slightly.
Submission.effect: User receives 1/4 the damage it inflicts in recoil.

Low Kick.flavorText: A powerful low kick that makes the target fall over. It inflicts greater damage on heavier targets.
Low Kick.effect: Inflicts more damage to heavier targets, with a maximum of 120 power.

Counter.flavorText: A retaliation move that counters any physical attack, inflicting double the damage taken.
Counter.effect: Inflicts twice the damage the user received from the last physical hit it took.

Seismic Toss.flavorText: The target is thrown using the power of gravity. It inflicts damage equal to the user’s level.
Seismic Toss.effect: Inflicts damage equal to the user’s level.

Strength.flavorText: The target is slugged with a punch thrown at maximum power. It can also be used to move heavy boulders.
Strength.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

Absorb.flavorText: A nutrient-draining attack. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.
Absorb.effect: Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.

Mega Drain.flavorText: A nutrient-draining attack. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.
Mega Drain.effect: Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.

Leech Seed.flavorText: A seed is planted on the target. It steals some HP from the target every turn.
Leech Seed.effect: Seeds the target, stealing HP from it every turn.

Growth.flavorText: The user’s body grows all at once, raising the Attack and Sp. Atk stats.
Growth.effect: Raises the user’s Attack and Special Attack by one stage.

Razor Leaf.flavorText: Sharp-edged leaves are launched to slash at the opposing team. Critical hits land more easily.
Razor Leaf.effect: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.

Solar Beam.flavorText: A two-turn attack. The user gathers light, then blasts a bundled beam on the second turn.
Solar Beam.effect: Requires a turn to charge before attacking.

Poison Powder.flavorText: The user scatters a cloud of poisonous dust on the target. It may poison the target.

Stun Spore.flavorText: The user scatters a cloud of paralyzing powder. It may leave the target with paralysis.

Sleep Powder.flavorText: The user scatters a big cloud of sleep-inducing dust around the target.

Petal Dance.flavorText: The user attacks the target by scattering petals for two to three turns. The user then becomes confused.
Petal Dance.effect: Hits every turn for 2-3 turns, then confuses the user.

String Shot.flavorText: The targets are bound with silk blown from the user’s mouth. This silk reduces the targets’ Speed stat.
String Shot.effect: Lowers the target’s Speed by two stages.

Dragon Rage.flavorText: This attack hits the target with a shock wave of pure rage. This attack always inflicts 40 HP damage.

Fire Spin.flavorText: The target becomes trapped within a fierce vortex of fire that rages for four to five turns.
Fire Spin.effect: Prevents the target from fleeing and inflicts damage for 2-5 turns.

Thunder Shock.flavorText: A jolt of electricity is hurled at the target to inflict damage. It may also leave the target with paralysis.
Thunder Shock.effect: Has a chance to paralyze the target.

Thunderbolt.flavorText: A strong electric blast is loosed at the target. It may also leave the target with paralysis.
Thunderbolt.effect: Has a chance to paralyze the target.

Thunder Wave.flavorText: A weak electric charge is launched at the target. It causes paralysis if it hits.

Thunder.flavorText: A wicked thunderbolt is dropped on the target to inflict damage. It may also leave the target with paralysis.
Thunder.effect: Has a chance to paralyze the target.

Rock Throw.flavorText: The user picks up and throws a small rock at the target to attack.
Rock Throw.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

Earthquake.flavorText: The user sets off an earthquake that strikes those around it.
Earthquake.effect: Inflicts regular damage and can hit Dig users.

Fissure.flavorText: The user opens up a fissure in the ground and drops the target in. The target instantly faints if it hits.

Dig.flavorText: The user burrows, then attacks on the second turn. It can also be used to exit dungeons.
Dig.effect: User digs underground, dodging all attacks, and hits next turn.

Toxic.flavorText: A move that leaves the target badly poisoned. Its poison damage worsens every turn.
Toxic.effect: Badly poisons the target, inflicting more damage every turn.

Confusion.flavorText: The target is hit by a weak telekinetic force. It may also leave the target confused.
Confusion.effect: Has a chance to confuse the target.

Psychic.flavorText: The target is hit by a strong telekinetic force. It may also reduce the target’s Sp. Def stat.
Psychic.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.

Hypnosis.flavorText: The user employs hypnotic suggestion to make the target fall into a deep sleep.

Meditate.flavorText: The user meditates to awaken the power deep within its body and raise its Attack stat.
Meditate.effect: Raises the user’s Attack by one stage.

Agility.flavorText: The user relaxes and lightens its body to move faster. It sharply boosts the Speed stat.
Agility.effect: Raises the user’s Speed by two stages.

Quick Attack.flavorText: The user lunges at the target at a speed that makes it almost invisible. It is sure to strike first.
Quick Attack.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

Rage.flavorText: As long as this move is in use, the power of rage raises the Attack stat each time the user is hit in battle.
Rage.effect: If the user is hit after using this move, its Attack rises by one stage.

Teleport.flavorText: Use it to flee from any wild Pokémon. It can also warp to the last Pokémon Center visited.
Teleport.effect: Immediately ends wild battles. No effect otherwise.

Night Shade.flavorText: The user makes the target see a frightening mirage. It inflicts damage matching the user’s level.
Night Shade.effect: Inflicts damage equal to the user’s level.

Mimic.flavorText: The user copies the target’s last move. The move can be used during battle until the Pokémon is switched out.
Mimic.effect: Copies the target’s last used move.

Screech.flavorText: An earsplitting screech harshly reduces the target’s Defense stat.
Screech.effect: Lowers the target’s Defense by two stages.

Double Team.flavorText: By moving rapidly, the user makes illusory copies of itself to raise its evasiveness.
Double Team.effect: Raises the user’s evasion by one stage.

Recover.flavorText: Restoring its own cells, the user restores its own HP by half of its max HP.
Recover.effect: Heals the user by half its max HP.

Harden.flavorText: The user stiffens all the muscles in its body to raise its Defense stat.
Harden.effect: Raises the user’s Defense by one stage.

Minimize.flavorText: The user compresses its body to make itself look smaller, which sharply raises its evasiveness.
Minimize.effect: Raises the user’s evasion by two stages.

Smokescreen.flavorText: The user releases an obscuring cloud of smoke or ink. It reduces the target’s accuracy.
Smokescreen.effect: Lowers the target’s accuracy by one stage.

Confuse Ray.flavorText: The target is exposed to a sinister ray that triggers confusion.

Withdraw.flavorText: The user withdraws its body into its hard shell, raising its Defense stat.
Withdraw.effect: Raises the user’s Defense by one stage.

Defense Curl.flavorText: The user curls up to conceal weak spots and raise its Defense stat.
Defense Curl.effect: Raises user’s Defense by one stage.

Barrier.flavorText: The user throws up a sturdy wall that sharply raises its Defense stat.
Barrier.effect: Raises the user’s Defense by two stages.

Light Screen.flavorText: A wondrous wall of light is put up to suppress damage from special attacks for five turns.
Light Screen.effect: Reduces damage from special attacks by 50% for five turns.

Haze.flavorText: The user creates a haze that eliminates every stat change among all the Pokémon engaged in battle.
Haze.effect: Resets all Pokémon’s stats, accuracy, and evasion.

Reflect.flavorText: A wondrous wall of light is put up to suppress damage from physical attacks for five turns.
Reflect.effect: Reduces damage from physical attacks by half.

Focus Energy.flavorText: The user takes a deep breath and focuses so that critical hits land more easily.
Focus Energy.effect: Increases the user’s chance to score a critical hit.

Bide.flavorText: The user endures attacks for two turns, then strikes back to cause double the damage taken.
Bide.effect: User waits for two turns, then hits back for twice the damage it took.

Metronome.flavorText: The user waggles a finger and stimulates its brain into randomly using nearly any move.
Metronome.effect: Randomly selects and uses any move in the game.

Mirror Move.flavorText: The user counters the target by mimicking the target’s last move.
Mirror Move.effect: Uses the target’s last used move.

Self-Destruct.flavorText: The user attacks everything around it by causing an explosion. The user faints upon using this move.

Egg Bomb.flavorText: A large egg is hurled at the target with maximum force to inflict damage.
Egg Bomb.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

Lick.flavorText: The target is licked with a long tongue, causing damage. It may also leave the target with paralysis.
Lick.effect: Has a chance to paralyze the target.

Smog.flavorText: The target is attacked with a discharge of filthy gases. It may also poison the target.
Smog.effect: Has a chance to poison the target.

Sludge.flavorText: Unsanitary sludge is hurled at the target. It may also poison the target.
Sludge.effect: Has a chance to poison the target.

Bone Club.flavorText: The user clubs the target with a bone. It may also make the target flinch.
Bone Club.effect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.

Fire Blast.flavorText: The target is attacked with an intense blast of all-consuming fire. It may also leave the target with a burn.
Fire Blast.effect: Has a chance to burn the target.

Waterfall.flavorText: The user charges at the target and may make it flinch. It can also be used to climb a waterfall.
Waterfall.effect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.

Clamp.flavorText: The target is clamped and squeezed by the user’s very thick and sturdy shell for four to five turns.
Clamp.effect: Prevents the target from fleeing and inflicts damage for 2-5 turns.

Swift.flavorText: Star-shaped rays are shot at the opposing team. This attack never misses.

Skull Bash.flavorText: The user tucks in its head to raise its Defense in the first turn, then rams the target on the next turn.
Skull Bash.effect: Raises the user’s Defense by one stage. User charges for one turn before attacking.

Spike Cannon.flavorText: Sharp spikes are shot at the target in rapid succession. They hit two to five times in a row.

Constrict.flavorText: The target is attacked with long, creeping tentacles or vines. It may also lower the target’s Speed stat.
Constrict.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.

Amnesia.flavorText: The user temporarily empties its mind to forget its concerns. It sharply raises the user’s Sp. Def stat.
Amnesia.effect: Raises the user’s Special Defense by two stages.

Kinesis.flavorText: The user distracts the target by bending a spoon. It lowers the target’s accuracy.
Kinesis.effect: Lowers the target’s accuracy by one stage.

Soft-Boiled.flavorText: The user restores its own HP by up to half of its maximum HP. May also be used in the field to heal HP.
Soft-Boiled.effect: Heals the user by half its max HP.

High Jump Kick.flavorText: The target is attacked with a knee kick from a jump. If it misses, the user is hurt instead.
High Jump Kick.effect: If the user misses, it takes half the damage it would have inflicted in recoil.

Glare.flavorText: The user intimidates the target with the pattern on its belly to cause paralysis.

Dream Eater.flavorText: The user eats the dreams of a sleeping target. It absorbs half the damage caused to heal the user’s HP.
Dream Eater.effect: Only works on sleeping Pokémon. Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.

Poison Gas.flavorText: A cloud of poison gas is sprayed in the face of opposing Pokémon. It may poison those hit.

Barrage.flavorText: Round objects are hurled at the target to strike two to five times in a row.

Leech Life.flavorText: The user drains the target’s blood. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.
Leech Life.effect: Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.

Lovely Kiss.flavorText: With a scary face, the user tries to force a kiss on the target. If it succeeds, the target falls asleep.

Sky Attack.flavorText: A second-turn attack move where critical hits land more easily. It may also make the target flinch.
Sky Attack.effect: User charges for one turn before attacking. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

Transform.flavorText: The user transforms into a copy of the target right down to having the same move set.
Transform.effect: User becomes a copy of the target until it leaves battle.

Bubble.flavorText: A spray of countless bubbles is jetted at the opposing team. It may also lower the targets’ Speed stats.
Bubble.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.

Dizzy Punch.flavorText: The target is hit with rhythmically launched punches that may also leave it confused.
Dizzy Punch.effect: Has a chance to confuse the target.

Spore.flavorText: The user scatters bursts of spores that induce sleep.

Flash.flavorText: The user flashes a bright light that cuts the target’s accuracy. It can also be used to illuminate caves.
Flash.effect: Lowers the target’s accuracy by one stage.

Psywave.flavorText: The target is attacked with an odd psychic wave. The attack varies in intensity.
Psywave.effect: Inflicts damage between 50% and 150% of the user’s level.

Splash.flavorText: The user just flops and splashes around to no effect at all...

Acid Armor.flavorText: The user alters its cellular structure to liquefy itself, sharply raising its Defense stat.
Acid Armor.effect: Raises the user’s Defense by two stages.

Crabhammer.flavorText: The target is hammered with a large pincer. Critical hits land more easily.
Crabhammer.effect: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.

Explosion.flavorText: The user explodes to inflict damage on those around it. The user faints upon using this move.

Fury Swipes.flavorText: The target is raked with sharp claws or scythes for two to five times in quick succession.

Bonemerang.flavorText: The user throws the bone it holds. The bone loops to hit the target twice, coming and going.

Rest.flavorText: The user goes to sleep for two turns. It fully restores the user’s HP and heals any status problem.
Rest.effect: User sleeps for two turns, completely healing itself.

Rock Slide.flavorText: Large boulders are hurled at the opposing team to inflict damage. It may also make the targets flinch.
Rock Slide.effect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.

Hyper Fang.flavorText: The user bites hard on the target with its sharp front fangs. It may also make the target flinch.
Hyper Fang.effect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.

Sharpen.flavorText: The user reduces its polygon count to make itself more jagged, raising the Attack stat.
Sharpen.effect: Raises the user’s Attack by one stage.

Conversion.flavorText: The user changes its type to become the same type as one of its moves.
Conversion.effect: User’s type changes to the type of one of its moves at random.

Tri Attack.flavorText: The user strikes with a simultaneous three-beam attack. May also burn, freeze, or leave the target with paralysis.
Tri Attack.effect: Has a chance to burn, freeze, or paralyze the target.

Super Fang.flavorText: The user chomps hard on the target with its sharp front fangs. It cuts the target’s HP to half.
Super Fang.effect: Inflicts damage equal to half the target’s HP.

Slash.flavorText: The target is attacked with a slash of claws or blades. Critical hits land more easily.
Slash.effect: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.

Substitute.flavorText: The user makes a copy of itself using some of its HP. The copy serves as the user’s decoy.
Substitute.effect: Transfers 1/4 of the user’s max HP into a doll, protecting the user from further damage or status changes until it breaks.

Struggle.flavorText: An attack that is used in desperation only if the user has no PP. It also hurts the user slightly.
Struggle.effect: User takes 1/4 its max HP in recoil.

Sketch.flavorText: It enables the user to permanently learn the move last used by the target. Once used, Sketch disappears.
Sketch.effect: Permanently becomes the target’s last used move.

Triple Kick.flavorText: A consecutive three-kick attack that becomes more powerful with each successive hit.
Triple Kick.effect: Hits three times, increasing power by 100% with each successful hit.

Thief.flavorText: The user attacks and steals the target’s held item simultaneously. It can’t steal if the user holds an item.

Spider Web.flavorText: The user ensnares the target with thin, gooey silk so it can’t flee from battle.
Spider Web.effect: Prevents the target from leaving battle.

Mind Reader.flavorText: The user senses the target’s movements with its mind to ensure its next attack does not miss the target.
Mind Reader.effect: Ensures that the user’s next move will hit the target.

Nightmare.flavorText: A sleeping target sees a nightmare that inflicts some damage every turn.
Nightmare.effect: Target loses 1/4 its max HP every turn as long as it’s asleep.

Flame Wheel.flavorText: The user cloaks itself in fire and charges at the target. It may also leave the target with a burn.
Flame Wheel.effect: Has a chance to burn the target. Lets frozen Pokémon thaw themselves.

Snore.flavorText: An attack that can be used only if the user is asleep. The harsh noise may also make the target flinch.
Snore.effect: Has a chance to make the target flinch. Only works if the user is sleeping.

Curse.flavorText: A move that works differently for the Ghost type than for all other types.
Curse.effect: Ghosts pay half their max HP to hurt the target every turn. Others decrease Speed but raise Attack and Defense.

Flail.flavorText: The user flails about aimlessly to attack. It becomes more powerful the less HP the user has.
Flail.effect: Inflicts more damage when the user has less HP remaining, with a maximum of 200 power.

Conversion 2.flavorText: The user changes its type to make itself resistant to the type of the attack the opponent used last.
Conversion 2.effect: Changes the user’s type to a random type either resistant or immune to the last move used against it.

Aeroblast.flavorText: A vortex of air is shot at the target to inflict damage. Critical hits land more easily.
Aeroblast.effect: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.

Cotton Spore.flavorText: The user releases cotton-like spores that cling to the target, harshly reducing its Speed stat.
Cotton Spore.effect: Lowers the target’s Speed by two stages.

Reversal.flavorText: An all-out attack that becomes more powerful the less HP the user has.
Reversal.effect: Inflicts more damage when the user has less HP remaining, with a maximum of 200 power.

Spite.flavorText: The user unleashes its grudge on the move last used by the target by cutting 4 PP from it.
Spite.effect: Lowers the PP of the target’s last used move by 4.

Powder Snow.flavorText: The user attacks with a chilling gust of powdery snow. It may also freeze the targets.
Powder Snow.effect: Has a chance to freeze the target.

Protect.flavorText: It enables the user to evade all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.
Protect.effect: Prevents any moves from hitting the user this turn.

Mach Punch.flavorText: The user throws a punch at blinding speed. It is certain to strike first.
Mach Punch.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

Scary Face.flavorText: The user frightens the target with a scary face to harshly reduce its Speed stat.
Scary Face.effect: Lowers the target’s Speed by two stages.

Feint Attack.flavorText: The user approaches the target disarmingly, then throws a sucker punch. It hits without fail.

Sweet Kiss.flavorText: The user kisses the target with a sweet, angelic cuteness that causes confusion.

Belly Drum.flavorText: The user maximizes its Attack stat in exchange for HP equal to half its max HP.
Belly Drum.effect: User pays half its max HP to max out its Attack.

Sludge Bomb.flavorText: Unsanitary sludge is hurled at the target. It may also poison the target.
Sludge Bomb.effect: Has a chance to poison the target.

Mud-Slap.flavorText: The user hurls mud in the target’s face to inflict damage and lower its accuracy.
Mud-Slap.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s accuracy by one stage.

Octazooka.flavorText: The user attacks by spraying ink in the target’s face or eyes. It may also lower the target’s accuracy.
Octazooka.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s accuracy by one stage.

Spikes.flavorText: The user lays a trap of spikes at the opposing team’s feet. The trap hurts Pokémon that switch into battle.
Spikes.effect: Scatters Spikes, hurting opposing Pokémon that switch in.

Zap Cannon.flavorText: The user fires an electric blast like a cannon to inflict damage and cause paralysis.
Zap Cannon.effect: Has a chance to paralyze the target.

Foresight.flavorText: Enables a Ghost-type target to be hit by Normal- and Fighting-type attacks. It also enables an evasive target to be hit.
Foresight.effect: Forces the target to have no Evade, and allows it to be hit by Normal and Fighting moves even if it’s a Ghost.

Destiny Bond.flavorText: When this move is used, if the user faints, the Pokémon that landed the knockout hit also faints.
Destiny Bond.effect: If the user faints this turn, the target automatically will, too.

Perish Song.flavorText: Any Pokémon that hears this song faints in three turns, unless it switches out of battle.
Perish Song.effect: User and target both faint after three turns.

Icy Wind.flavorText: The user attacks with a gust of chilled air. It also reduces the targets’ Speed stat.
Icy Wind.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.

Detect.flavorText: It enables the user to evade all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.
Detect.effect: Prevents any moves from hitting the user this turn.

Bone Rush.flavorText: The user strikes the target with a hard bone two to five times in a row.

Lock-On.flavorText: The user takes sure aim at the target. It ensures the next attack does not fail to hit the target.
Lock-On.effect: Ensures that the user’s next move will hit the target.

Outrage.flavorText: The user rampages and attacks for two to three turns. It then becomes confused, however.
Outrage.effect: Hits every turn for 2-3 turns, then confuses the user.

Sandstorm.flavorText: A five-turn sandstorm is summoned to hurt all combatants except the Rock, Ground, and Steel types.
Sandstorm.effect: Changes the weather to a sandstorm for five turns.

Giga Drain.flavorText: A nutrient-draining attack. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.
Giga Drain.effect: Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.

Endure.flavorText: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.
Endure.effect: Prevents the user’s HP from lowering below 1 this turn.

Charm.flavorText: The user gazes at the target rather charmingly, making it less wary. The target’s Attack is harshly lowered.
Charm.effect: Lowers the target’s Attack by two stages.

Rollout.flavorText: The user continually rolls into the target over five turns. It becomes stronger each time it hits.
Rollout.effect: Power doubles every turn this move is used in succession after the first, resetting after five turns.

False Swipe.flavorText: A restrained attack that prevents the target from fainting. The target is left with at least 1 HP.
False Swipe.effect: Cannot lower the target’s HP below 1.

Swagger.flavorText: The user enrages and confuses the target. However, it also sharply raises the target’s Attack stat.
Swagger.effect: Raises the target’s Attack by two stages and confuses the target.

Milk Drink.flavorText: The user restores its own HP by up to half of its maximum HP. May also be used in the field to heal HP.
Milk Drink.effect: Heals the user by half its max HP.

Spark.flavorText: The user throws an electrically charged tackle at the target. It may also leave the target with paralysis.
Spark.effect: Has a chance to paralyze the target.

Fury Cutter.flavorText: The target is slashed with scythes or claws. Its power increases if it hits in succession.
Fury Cutter.effect: Power doubles every turn this move is used in succession after the first, maxing out after five turns.

Steel Wing.flavorText: The target is hit with wings of steel. It may also raise the user’s Defense stat.
Steel Wing.effect: Has a chance to raise the user’s Defense by one stage.

Mean Look.flavorText: The user pins the target with a dark, arresting look. The target becomes unable to flee.
Mean Look.effect: Prevents the target from leaving battle.

Attract.flavorText: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the target becomes infatuated and less likely to attack.
Attract.effect: Target falls in love if it has the opposite gender, and has a 50% chance to refuse attacking the user.

Sleep Talk.flavorText: While it is asleep, the user randomly uses one of the moves it knows.
Sleep Talk.effect: Randomly uses one of the user’s other three moves. Only works if the user is sleeping.

Heal Bell.flavorText: The user makes a soothing bell chime to heal the status problems of all the party Pokémon.
Heal Bell.effect: Cures the entire party of major status effects.

Return.flavorText: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the more the user likes its Trainer.
Return.effect: Power increases with happiness, up to a maximum of 102.

Present.flavorText: The user attacks by giving the target a gift with a hidden trap. It restores HP sometimes, however.
Present.effect: Randomly inflicts damage with power from 40 to 120 or heals the target for 1/4 its max HP.

Frustration.flavorText: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the less the user likes its Trainer.
Frustration.effect: Power increases as happiness decreases, up to a maximum of 102.

Safeguard.flavorText: The user creates a protective field that prevents status problems for five turns.
Safeguard.effect: Protects the user’s field from major status ailments and confusion for five turns.

Pain Split.flavorText: The user adds its HP to the target’s HP, then equally shares the combined HP with the target.
Pain Split.effect: Sets the user’s and targets’s HP to the average of their current HP.

Sacred Fire.flavorText: The target is razed with a mystical fire of great intensity. It may also leave the target with a burn.
Sacred Fire.effect: Has a chance to burn the target. Lets frozen Pokémon thaw themselves.

Magnitude.flavorText: The user looses a ground-shaking quake affecting everyone around the user. Its power varies.

Dynamic Punch.flavorText: The user punches the target with full, concentrated power. It confuses the target if it hits.
Dynamic Punch.effect: Has a chance to confuse the target.

Megahorn.flavorText: Using its tough and impressive horn, the user rams into the target with no letup.
Megahorn.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

Dragon Breath.flavorText: The user exhales a mighty gust that inflicts damage. It may also leave the target with paralysis.
Dragon Breath.effect: Has a chance to paralyze the target.

Baton Pass.flavorText: The user switches places with a party Pokémon in waiting, passing along any stat changes.
Baton Pass.effect: Allows the trainer to switch out the user and pass effects along to its replacement.

Encore.flavorText: The user compels the target to keep using only the move it last used for three turns.
Encore.effect: Forces the target to repeat its last used move every turn for 2 to 6 turns.

Pursuit.flavorText: An attack move that inflicts double damage if used on a target that is switching out of battle.
Pursuit.effect: Has double power against, and can hit, Pokémon attempting to switch out.

Rapid Spin.flavorText: A spin attack that can also eliminate such moves as Bind, Wrap, Leech Seed, and Spikes.
Rapid Spin.effect: Frees the user from binding moves, removes Leech Seed, and blows away Spikes.

Sweet Scent.flavorText: A sweet scent that lowers the opposing team’s evasiveness. It also lures wild Pokémon if used in grass, etc.
Sweet Scent.effect: Lowers the target’s evasion by one stage.

Iron Tail.flavorText: The target is slammed with a steel-hard tail. It may also lower the target’s Defense stat.
Iron Tail.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage.

Metal Claw.flavorText: The target is raked with steel claws. It may also raise the user’s Attack stat.
Metal Claw.effect: Has a chance to raise the user’s Attack by one stage.

Vital Throw.flavorText: The user attacks last. In return, this throw move is guaranteed not to miss.

Morning Sun.flavorText: The user restores its own HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.
Morning Sun.effect: Heals the user by half its max HP. Affected by weather.

Synthesis.flavorText: The user restores its own HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.
Synthesis.effect: Heals the user by half its max HP. Affected by weather.

Moonlight.flavorText: The user restores its own HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.
Moonlight.effect: Heals the user by half its max HP. Affected by weather.

Hidden Power.flavorText: A unique attack that varies in type and intensity depending on the Pokémon using it.
Hidden Power.effect: Power and type depend upon user’s IVs. Power can range from 30 to 70.

Cross Chop.flavorText: The user delivers a double chop with its forearms crossed. Critical hits land more easily.
Cross Chop.effect: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.

Twister.flavorText: The user whips up a vicious tornado to tear at the opposing team. It may also make targets flinch.
Twister.effect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.

Rain Dance.flavorText: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns, powering up Water-type moves.
Rain Dance.effect: Changes the weather to rain for five turns.

Sunny Day.flavorText: The user intensifies the sun for five turns, powering up Fire-type moves.
Sunny Day.effect: Changes the weather to sunny for five turns.

Crunch.flavorText: The user crunches up the target with sharp fangs. It may also lower the target’s Defense stat.
Crunch.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage.

Mirror Coat.flavorText: A retaliation move that counters any special attack, inflicting double the damage taken.
Mirror Coat.effect: Inflicts twice the damage the user received from the last special hit it took.

Psych Up.flavorText: The user hypnotizes itself into copying any stat change made by the target.
Psych Up.effect: Discards the user’s stat changes and copies the target’s.

Extreme Speed.flavorText: The user charges the target at blinding speed. This attack always goes before any other move.
Extreme Speed.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

Ancient Power.flavorText: The user attacks with a prehistoric power. It may also raise all the user’s stats at once.
Ancient Power.effect: Has a chance to raise all of the user’s stats by one stage.

Shadow Ball.flavorText: The user hurls a shadowy blob at the target. It may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.
Shadow Ball.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.

Future Sight.flavorText: Two turns after this move is used, a hunk of psychic energy attacks the target.
Future Sight.effect: Hits the target two turns later.

Rock Smash.flavorText: The user attacks with a punch that can shatter a rock. It may also lower the target’s Defense stat.
Rock Smash.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage.

Whirlpool.flavorText: Traps foes in a violent swirling whirlpool for four to five turns.
Whirlpool.effect: Prevents the target from leaving battle and inflicts 1/16 its max HP in damage for 2-5 turns.

Beat Up.flavorText: The user gets all party Pokémon to attack the target. The more party Pokémon, the greater the number of attacks.
Beat Up.effect: Hits once for every conscious Pokémon the trainer has.

Fake Out.flavorText: An attack that hits first and makes the target flinch. It only works the first turn the user is in battle.
Fake Out.effect: Can only be used as the first move after the user enters battle. Causes the target to flinch.

Uproar.flavorText: The user attacks in an uproar for three turns. Over that time, no one can fall asleep.
Uproar.effect: Forced to use this move for several turns. Pokémon cannot fall asleep in that time.

Stockpile.flavorText: The user charges up power and raises both its Defense and Sp. Def. The move can be used three times.
Stockpile.effect: Stores energy up to three times for use with Spit Up and Swallow.

Spit Up.flavorText: The power stored using the move Stockpile is released at once in an attack. The more power is stored, the greater the damage.
Spit Up.effect: Power is 100 times the amount of energy Stockpiled.

Swallow.flavorText: The power stored using the move Stockpile is absorbed by the user to heal its HP. Storing more power heals more HP.
Swallow.effect: Recovers 1/4 HP after one Stockpile, 1/2 HP after two Stockpiles, or full HP after three Stockpiles.

Heat Wave.flavorText: The user attacks by exhaling hot breath on the opposing team. It may also leave targets with a burn.
Heat Wave.effect: Has a chance to burn the target.

Hail.flavorText: The user summons a hailstorm lasting five turns. It damages all Pokémon except the Ice type.
Hail.effect: Changes the weather to a hailstorm for five turns.

Torment.flavorText: The user torments and enrages the target, making it incapable of using the same move twice in a row.
Torment.effect: Prevents the target from using the same move twice in a row.

Flatter.flavorText: Flattery is used to confuse the target. However, it also raises the target’s Sp. Atk stat.
Flatter.effect: Raises the target’s Special Attack by one stage and confuses the target.

Will-O-Wisp.flavorText: The user shoots a sinister, bluish-white flame at the target to inflict a burn.

Memento.flavorText: The user faints when using this move. In return, it harshly lowers the target’s Attack and Sp. Atk.
Memento.effect: Lowers the target’s Attack and Special Attack by two stages. User faints.

Facade.flavorText: An attack move that doubles its power if the user is poisoned, burned, or has paralysis.
Facade.effect: Power doubles if user is burned, paralyzed, or poisoned.

Focus Punch.flavorText: The user focuses its mind before launching a punch. It will fail if the user is hit before it is used.
Focus Punch.effect: If the user takes damage before attacking, the attack is canceled.

Smelling Salts.flavorText: This attack inflicts double damage on a target with paralysis. It also cures the target’s paralysis, however.
Smelling Salts.effect: If the target is paralyzed, inflicts double damage and cures the paralysis.

Follow Me.flavorText: The user draws attention to itself, making all targets take aim only at the user.
Follow Me.effect: Redirects the target’s single-target effects to the user for this turn.

Nature Power.flavorText: An attack that makes use of nature’s power. Its effects vary depending on the user’s environment.
Nature Power.effect: Uses a move which depends upon the terrain.

Charge.flavorText: The user boosts the power of the Electric move it uses on the next turn. It also raises the user’s Sp. Def stat.
Charge.effect: Raises the user’s Special Defense by one stage. User’s Electric moves have doubled power next turn.

Taunt.flavorText: The target is taunted into a rage that allows it to use only attack moves for three turns.
Taunt.effect: For the next few turns, the target can only use damaging moves.

Helping Hand.flavorText: The user assists an ally by boosting the power of its attack.
Helping Hand.effect: Ally’s next move inflicts half more damage.

Trick.flavorText: The user catches the target off guard and swaps its held item with its own.

Role Play.flavorText: The user mimics the target completely, copying the target’s natural Ability.

Wish.flavorText: One turn after this move is used, the target’s HP is restored by half the user’s maximum HP.
Wish.effect: User will recover half its max HP at the end of the next turn.

Assist.flavorText: The user hurriedly and randomly uses a move among those known by other Pokémon in the party.
Assist.effect: Randomly selects and uses one of the trainer’s other Pokémon’s moves.

Ingrain.flavorText: The user lays roots that restore its HP on every turn. Because it is rooted, it can’t switch out.
Ingrain.effect: Prevents the user from leaving battle. User regains 1/16 of its max HP every turn.

Superpower.flavorText: The user attacks the target with great power. However, it also lowers the user’s Attack and Defense.
Superpower.effect: Lowers the user’s Attack and Defense by one stage after inflicting damage.

Magic Coat.flavorText: A barrier reflects back to the target moves like Leech Seed and moves that damage status.
Magic Coat.effect: Reflects back the first effect move used on the user this turn.

Recycle.flavorText: The user recycles a held item that has been used in battle so it can be used again.
Recycle.effect: User recovers the item it last used up.

Revenge.flavorText: An attack move that inflicts double the damage if the user has been hurt by the opponent in the same turn.
Revenge.effect: Inflicts double damage if the user takes damage before attacking this turn.

Brick Break.flavorText: The user attacks with a swift chop. It can also break any barrier such as Light Screen and Reflect.

Yawn.flavorText: The user lets loose a huge yawn that lulls the target into falling asleep on the next turn.
Yawn.effect: Target sleeps at the end of the next turn.

Knock Off.flavorText: The user slaps down the target’s held item, preventing that item from being used in the battle.

Endeavor.flavorText: An attack move that cuts down the target’s HP to equal the user’s HP.
Endeavor.effect: Lowers the target’s HP to equal the user’s.

Eruption.flavorText: The user attacks the opposing team with explosive fury. The lower the user’s HP, the less powerful this attack becomes.
Eruption.effect: Inflicts more damage when the user has more HP remaining, with a maximum of 150 power.

Skill Swap.flavorText: The user employs its psychic power to exchange Abilities with the target.

Imprison.flavorText: If the opponents know any move also known by the user, the opponents are prevented from using it.
Imprison.effect: Prevents the target from using any moves that the user also knows.

Refresh.flavorText: The user rests to cure itself of a poisoning, burn, or paralysis.
Refresh.effect: Cleanses the user of a burn, paralysis, or poison.

Grudge.flavorText: If the user faints, the user’s grudge fully depletes the PP of the opponent’s move that knocked it out.
Grudge.effect: If the user faints this turn, the PP of the move that fainted it drops to 0.

Snatch.flavorText: The user steals the effects of any healing or stat-changing move the opponent attempts to use.
Snatch.effect: Steals the target’s move, if it’s self-targeted.

Secret Power.flavorText: The user attacks the target with a secret power. Its added effects vary depending on the user’s environment.
Secret Power.effect: Has a chance to inflict a status effect which depends upon the terrain.

Dive.flavorText: Diving on the first turn, the user floats up and attacks on the second turn. It can be used to dive deep in the ocean.
Dive.effect: User dives underwater, dodging all attacks, and hits next turn.

Arm Thrust.flavorText: The user looses a flurry of open-palmed arm thrusts that hit two to five times in a row.

Camouflage.flavorText: The user’s type is changed depending on its environment, such as at water’s edge, in grass, or in a cave.
Camouflage.effect: User’s type changes to match the terrain.

Tail Glow.flavorText: The user stares at flashing lights to focus its mind, drastically raising its Sp. Atk stat.
Tail Glow.effect: Raises the user’s Special Attack by three stages.

Luster Purge.flavorText: The user lets loose a damaging burst of light. It may also reduce the target’s Sp. Def stat.
Luster Purge.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.

Mist Ball.flavorText: A mistlike flurry of down envelops and damages the target. It may also lower the target’s Sp. Atk.
Mist Ball.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Attack by one stage.

Feather Dance.flavorText: The user covers the target’s body with a mass of down that harshly lowers its Attack stat.
Feather Dance.effect: Lowers the target’s Attack by two stages.

Teeter Dance.flavorText: The user performs a wobbly dance that confuses the Pokémon around it.

Blaze Kick.flavorText: The user launches a kick that lands a critical hit more easily. It may also leave the target with a burn.
Blaze Kick.effect: Has an increased chance for a critical hit and a chance to burn the target.

Mud Sport.flavorText: The user covers itself with mud. It weakens Electric-type moves while the user is in the battle.

Ice Ball.flavorText: The user continually rolls into the target over five turns. It becomes stronger each time it hits.
Ice Ball.effect: Power doubles every turn this move is used in succession after the first, resetting after five turns.

Needle Arm.flavorText: The user attacks by wildly swinging its thorny arms. It may also make the target flinch.
Needle Arm.effect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.

Slack Off.flavorText: The user slacks off, restoring its own HP by up to half of its maximum HP.
Slack Off.effect: Heals the user by half its max HP.

Hyper Voice.flavorText: The user lets loose a horribly echoing shout with the power to inflict damage.
Hyper Voice.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

Poison Fang.flavorText: The user bites the target with toxic fangs. It may also leave the target badly poisoned.
Poison Fang.effect: Has a chance to badly poison the target.

Crush Claw.flavorText: The user slashes the target with hard and sharp claws. It may also lower the target’s Defense.
Crush Claw.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage.

Blast Burn.flavorText: The target is razed by a fiery explosion. The user must rest on the next turn, however.
Blast Burn.effect: User foregoes its next turn to recharge.

Hydro Cannon.flavorText: The target is hit with a watery blast. The user must rest on the next turn, however.
Hydro Cannon.effect: User foregoes its next turn to recharge.

Meteor Mash.flavorText: The target is hit with a hard punch fired like a meteor. It may also raise the user’s Attack.
Meteor Mash.effect: Has a chance to raise the user’s Attack by one stage.

Astonish.flavorText: The user attacks the target while shouting in a startling fashion. It may also make the target flinch.
Astonish.effect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.

Weather Ball.flavorText: An attack move that varies in power and type depending on the weather.
Weather Ball.effect: If there be weather, this move has doubled power and the weather’s type.

Aromatherapy.flavorText: The user releases a soothing scent that heals all status problems affecting the user’s party.
Aromatherapy.effect: Cures the entire party of major status effects.

Fake Tears.flavorText: The user feigns crying to fluster the target, harshly lowering its Sp. Def stat.
Fake Tears.effect: Lowers the target’s Special Defense by two stages.

Air Cutter.flavorText: The user launches razor-like wind to slash the opposing team. Critical hits land more easily.
Air Cutter.effect: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.

Overheat.flavorText: The user attacks the target at full power. The attack’s recoil harshly reduces the user’s Sp. Atk stat.
Overheat.effect: Lowers the user’s Special Attack by two stages after inflicting damage.

Odor Sleuth.flavorText: Enables a Ghost-type target to be hit with Normal- and Fighting-type attacks. It also enables an evasive target to be hit.
Odor Sleuth.effect: Forces the target to have no Evade, and allows it to be hit by Normal and Fighting moves even if it’s a Ghost.

Rock Tomb.flavorText: Boulders are hurled at the target. It also lowers the target’s Speed by preventing its movement.
Rock Tomb.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.

Silver Wind.flavorText: The target is attacked with powdery scales blown by wind. It may also raise all the user’s stats.
Silver Wind.effect: Has a chance to raise all of the user’s stats by one stage.

Metal Sound.flavorText: A horrible sound like scraping metal harshly reduces the target’s Sp. Def stat.
Metal Sound.effect: Lowers the target’s Special Defense by two stages.

Grass Whistle.flavorText: The user plays a pleasant melody that lulls the target into a deep sleep.

Tickle.flavorText: The user tickles the target into laughing, reducing its Attack and Defense stats.
Tickle.effect: Lowers the target’s Attack and Defense by one stage.

Cosmic Power.flavorText: The user absorbs a mystical power from space to raise its Defense and Sp. Def stats.
Cosmic Power.effect: Raises the user’s Defense and Special Defense by one stage.

Water Spout.flavorText: The user spouts water to damage the opposing team. The lower the user’s HP, the less powerful it becomes.
Water Spout.effect: Inflicts more damage when the user has more HP remaining, with a maximum of 150 power.

Signal Beam.flavorText: The user attacks with a sinister beam of light. It may also confuse the target.
Signal Beam.effect: Has a chance to confuse the target.

Shadow Punch.flavorText: The user throws a punch from the shadows. The punch lands without fail.

Extrasensory.flavorText: The user attacks with an odd, unseeable power. It may also make the target flinch.
Extrasensory.effect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.

Sky Uppercut.flavorText: The user attacks the target with an uppercut thrown skyward with force.
Sky Uppercut.effect: Inflicts regular damage and can hit Bounce and Fly users.

Sand Tomb.flavorText: The user traps the target inside a harshly raging sandstorm for four to five turns.
Sand Tomb.effect: Prevents the target from fleeing and inflicts damage for 2-5 turns.

Sheer Cold.flavorText: The target is attacked with a blast of absolute-zero cold. The target instantly faints if it hits.

Muddy Water.flavorText: The user attacks by shooting muddy water at the opposing team. It may also lower the targets’ accuracy.
Muddy Water.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s accuracy by one stage.

Bullet Seed.flavorText: The user forcefully shoots seeds at the target. Two to five seeds are shot in rapid succession.

Aerial Ace.flavorText: The user confounds the target with speed, then slashes. The attack lands without fail.

Icicle Spear.flavorText: The user launches sharp icicles at the target. It strikes two to five times in a row.

Iron Defense.flavorText: The user hardens its body’s surface like iron, sharply raising its Defense stat.
Iron Defense.effect: Raises the user’s Defense by two stages.

Block.flavorText: The user blocks the target’s way with arms spread wide to prevent escape.
Block.effect: Prevents the target from leaving battle.

Howl.flavorText: The user howls loudly to raise its spirit, boosting its Attack stat.
Howl.effect: Raises the user’s Attack by one stage.

Dragon Claw.flavorText: The user slashes the target with huge, sharp claws.
Dragon Claw.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

Frenzy Plant.flavorText: The user slams the target with an enormous tree. The user can’t move on the next turn.
Frenzy Plant.effect: User foregoes its next turn to recharge.

Bulk Up.flavorText: The user tenses its muscles to bulk up its body, boosting both its Attack and Defense stats.
Bulk Up.effect: Raises the user’s Attack and Defense by one stage.

Bounce.flavorText: The user bounces up high, then drops on the target on the second turn. It may also leave the target with paralysis.
Bounce.effect: User bounces high into the air, dodging all attacks, and hits next turn.

Mud Shot.flavorText: The user attacks by hurling a blob of mud at the target. It also reduces the target’s Speed.
Mud Shot.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.

Poison Tail.flavorText: The user hits the target with its tail. It may also poison the target. Critical hits land more easily.
Poison Tail.effect: Has an increased chance for a critical hit and a chance to poison the target.

Covet.flavorText: The user endearingly approaches the target, then steals the target’s held item.

Volt Tackle.flavorText: The user electrifies itself, then charges. It causes considerable damage to the user and may leave the target with paralysis.
Volt Tackle.effect: User takes 1/3 the damage inflicted in recoil. Has a chance to paralyze the target.

Magical Leaf.flavorText: The user scatters curious leaves that chase the target. This attack will not miss.

Water Sport.flavorText: The user soaks itself with water. The move weakens Fire-type moves while the user is in the battle.

Calm Mind.flavorText: The user quietly focuses its mind and calms its spirit to raise its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.
Calm Mind.effect: Raises the user’s Special Attack and Special Defense by one stage.

Leaf Blade.flavorText: The user handles a sharp leaf like a sword and attacks by cutting its target. Critical hits land more easily.
Leaf Blade.effect: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.

Dragon Dance.flavorText: The user vigorously performs a mystic, powerful dance that boosts its Attack and Speed stats.
Dragon Dance.effect: Raises the user’s Attack and Speed by one stage.

Rock Blast.flavorText: The user hurls hard rocks at the target. Two to five rocks are launched in quick succession.

Shock Wave.flavorText: The user strikes the target with a quick jolt of electricity. This attack cannot be evaded.

Water Pulse.flavorText: The user attacks the target with a pulsing blast of water. It may also confuse the target.
Water Pulse.effect: Has a chance to confuse the target.

Doom Desire.flavorText: Two turns after this move is used, the user blasts the target with a concentrated bundle of light.
Doom Desire.effect: Hits the target two turns later.

Psycho Boost.flavorText: The user attacks the target at full power. The attack’s recoil harshly reduces the user’s Sp. Atk stat.
Psycho Boost.effect: Lowers the user’s Special Attack by two stages after inflicting damage.

Roost.flavorText: The user lands and rests its body. It restores the user’s HP by up to half of its max HP.
Roost.effect: Heals the user by half its max HP.

Gravity.flavorText: Gravity is intensified for five turns, making moves involving flying unusable and negating Levitate.
Gravity.effect: Disables moves and immunities that involve flying or levitating for five turns.

Miracle Eye.flavorText: Enables a Dark-type target to be hit by Psychic-type attacks. It also enables an evasive target to be hit.
Miracle Eye.effect: Forces the target to have no evasion, and allows it to be hit by Psychic moves even if it’s Dark.

Wake-Up Slap.flavorText: This attack inflicts big damage on a sleeping target. It also wakes the target up, however.
Wake-Up Slap.effect: If the target is asleep, has double power and wakes it up.

Hammer Arm.flavorText: The user swings and hits with its strong and heavy fist. It lowers the user’s Speed, however.
Hammer Arm.effect: Lowers user’s Speed by one stage.

Gyro Ball.flavorText: The user tackles the target with a high-speed spin. The slower the user, the greater the damage.
Gyro Ball.effect: Power raises when the user has lower Speed, up to a maximum of 150.

Healing Wish.flavorText: The user faints. In return, the Pokémon taking its place will have its HP restored and status cured.
Healing Wish.effect: User faints. Its replacement has its HP fully restored and any major status effect removed.

Brine.flavorText: If the target’s HP is down to about half, this attack will hit with double the power.
Brine.effect: Has double power against Pokémon that have less than half their max HP remaining.

Natural Gift.flavorText: The user draws power to attack by using its held Berry. The Berry determines its type and power.
Natural Gift.effect: Power and type depend on the held berry.

Feint.flavorText: An attack that hits a target using Protect or Detect. It also lifts the effects of those moves.

Pluck.flavorText: The user pecks the target. If the target is holding a Berry, the user eats it and gains its effect.
Pluck.effect: If target has a berry, inflicts double damage and uses the berry.

Tailwind.flavorText: The user whips up a turbulent whirlwind that ups the Speed of all party Pokémon for four turns.
Tailwind.effect: For three turns, friendly Pokémon have doubled Speed.

Acupressure.flavorText: The user applies pressure to stress points, sharply boosting one of its stats.
Acupressure.effect: Raises one of a friendly Pokémon’s stats at random by two stages.

Metal Burst.flavorText: The user retaliates with much greater power against the target that last inflicted damage on it.
Metal Burst.effect: Strikes back at the last Pokémon to hit the user this turn with 1.5× the damage.

U-turn.flavorText: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.
U-turn.effect: User must switch out after attacking.

Close Combat.flavorText: The user fights the target up close without guarding itself. It also cuts the user’s Defense and Sp. Def.
Close Combat.effect: Lowers the user’s Defense and Special Defense by one stage after inflicting damage.

Payback.flavorText: If the user moves after the target, this attack’s power will be doubled.
Payback.effect: Power is doubled if the target has already moved this turn.

Assurance.flavorText: If the target has already taken some damage in the same turn, this attack’s power is doubled.
Assurance.effect: Power is doubled if the target has already received damage this turn.

Embargo.flavorText: It prevents the target from using its held item. Its Trainer is also prevented from using items on it.

Fling.flavorText: The user flings its held item at the target to attack. Its power and effects depend on the item.
Fling.effect: Throws held item at the target; power depends on the item.

Psycho Shift.flavorText: Using its psychic power of suggestion, the user transfers its status problems to the target.
Psycho Shift.effect: Transfers the user’s major status effect to the target.

Trump Card.flavorText: The fewer PP this move has, the greater its attack power.
Trump Card.effect: Power increases when this move has less PP, up to a maximum of 200.

Heal Block.flavorText: For five turns, the user prevents the opposing team from using any moves, Abilities, or held items that recover HP.
Heal Block.effect: Prevents target from restoring its HP for five turns.

Wring Out.flavorText: The user powerfully wrings the target. The more HP the target has, the greater this attack’s power.
Wring Out.effect: Power increases against targets with more HP remaining, up to a maximum of 121 power.

Power Trick.flavorText: The user employs its psychic power to switch its Attack with its Defense stat.

Gastro Acid.flavorText: The user hurls up its stomach acids on the target. The fluid eliminates the effect of the target’s Ability.
Gastro Acid.effect: Nullifies target’s ability until it leaves battle.

Lucky Chant.flavorText: The user chants an incantation toward the sky, preventing opposing Pokémon from landing critical hits.
Lucky Chant.effect: Prevents the target from scoring critical hits for five turns.

Me First.flavorText: The user tries to cut ahead of the target to steal and use the target’s intended move with greater power.
Me First.effect: Uses the target’s move against it before it attacks, with power increased by half.

Copycat.flavorText: The user mimics the move used immediately before it. The move fails if no other move has been used yet.
Copycat.effect: Uses the target’s last used move.

Power Swap.flavorText: The user employs its psychic power to switch changes to its Attack and Sp. Atk with the target.
Power Swap.effect: User swaps Attack and Special Attack changes with the target.

Guard Swap.flavorText: The user employs its psychic power to switch changes to its Defense and Sp. Def with the target.
Guard Swap.effect: User swaps Defense and Special Defense changes with the target.

Punishment.flavorText: This attack’s power increases the more the target has powered up with stat changes.
Punishment.effect: Power increases against targets with more raised stats, up to a maximum of 200.

Last Resort.flavorText: This move can be used only after the user has used all the other moves it knows in the battle.
Last Resort.effect: Can only be used after all of the user’s other moves have been used.

Worry Seed.flavorText: A seed that causes worry is planted on the target. It prevents sleep by making its Ability Insomnia.
Worry Seed.effect: Changes the target’s ability to Insomnia.

Sucker Punch.flavorText: This move enables the user to attack first. It fails if the target is not readying an attack, however.
Sucker Punch.effect: Only works if the target is about to use a damaging move.

Toxic Spikes.flavorText: The user lays a trap of poison spikes at the opponent’s feet. They poison opponents that switch into battle.
Toxic Spikes.effect: Scatters poisoned spikes, poisoning opposing Pokémon that switch in.

Heart Swap.flavorText: The user employs its psychic power to switch stat changes with the target.
Heart Swap.effect: User and target swap stat changes.

Aqua Ring.flavorText: The user envelops itself in a veil made of water. It regains some HP on every turn.
Aqua Ring.effect: Restores 1/16 of the user’s max HP each turn.

Magnet Rise.flavorText: The user levitates using electrically generated magnetism for five turns.
Magnet Rise.effect: User is immune to Ground moves and effects for five turns.

Flare Blitz.flavorText: The user cloaks itself in fire and charges at the target. The user sustains serious damage and may leave the target burned.
Flare Blitz.effect: User takes 1/3 the damage inflicted in recoil. Has a chance to burn the target.

Force Palm.flavorText: The target is attacked with a shock wave. It may also leave the target with paralysis.
Force Palm.effect: Has a chance to paralyze the target.

Aura Sphere.flavorText: The user looses a blast of aura power from deep within its body at the target. This move is certain to hit.

Rock Polish.flavorText: The user polishes its body to reduce drag. It can sharply raise the Speed stat.
Rock Polish.effect: Raises the user’s Speed by two stages.

Poison Jab.flavorText: The target is stabbed with a tentacle or arm steeped in poison. It may also poison the target.
Poison Jab.effect: Has a chance to poison the target.

Dark Pulse.flavorText: The user releases a horrible aura imbued with dark thoughts. It may also make the target flinch.
Dark Pulse.effect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.

Night Slash.flavorText: The user slashes the target the instant an opportunity arises. Critical hits land more easily.
Night Slash.effect: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.

Aqua Tail.flavorText: The user attacks by swinging its tail as if it were a vicious wave in a raging storm.
Aqua Tail.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

Seed Bomb.flavorText: The user slams a barrage of hard-shelled seeds down on the target from above.
Seed Bomb.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

Air Slash.flavorText: The user attacks with a blade of air that slices even the sky. It may also make the target flinch.
Air Slash.effect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.

X-Scissor.flavorText: The user slashes at the target by crossing its scythes or claws as if they were a pair of scissors.
X-Scissor.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

Bug Buzz.flavorText: The user vibrates its wings to generate a damaging sound wave. It may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.
Bug Buzz.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.

Dragon Pulse.flavorText: The target is attacked with a shock wave generated by the user’s gaping mouth.
Dragon Pulse.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

Dragon Rush.flavorText: The user tackles the target while exhibiting overwhelming menace. It may also make the target flinch.
Dragon Rush.effect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.

Power Gem.flavorText: The user attacks with a ray of light that sparkles as if it were made of gemstones.
Power Gem.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

Drain Punch.flavorText: An energy-draining punch. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.
Drain Punch.effect: Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.

Vacuum Wave.flavorText: The user whirls its fists to send a wave of pure vacuum at the target. This move always goes first.
Vacuum Wave.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

Focus Blast.flavorText: The user heightens its mental focus and unleashes its power. It may also lower the target’s Sp. Def.
Focus Blast.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.

Energy Ball.flavorText: The user draws power from nature and fires it at the target. It may also lower the target’s Sp. Def.
Energy Ball.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.

Brave Bird.flavorText: The user tucks in its wings and charges from a low altitude. The user also takes serious damage.
Brave Bird.effect: User receives 1/3 the damage inflicted in recoil.

Earth Power.flavorText: The user makes the ground under the target erupt with power. It may also lower the target’s Sp. Def.
Earth Power.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.

Switcheroo.flavorText: The user trades held items with the target faster than the eye can follow.

Giga Impact.flavorText: The user charges at the target using every bit of its power. The user must rest on the next turn.
Giga Impact.effect: User foregoes its next turn to recharge.

Nasty Plot.flavorText: The user stimulates its brain by thinking bad thoughts. It sharply raises the user’s Sp. Atk.
Nasty Plot.effect: Raises the user’s Special Attack by two stages.

Bullet Punch.flavorText: The user strikes the target with tough punches as fast as bullets. This move always goes first.
Bullet Punch.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

Avalanche.flavorText: An attack move that inflicts double the damage if the user has been hurt by the target in the same turn.
Avalanche.effect: Inflicts double damage if the user takes damage before attacking this turn.

Ice Shard.flavorText: The user flash freezes chunks of ice and hurls them at the target. This move always goes first.
Ice Shard.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

Shadow Claw.flavorText: The user slashes with a sharp claw made from shadows. Critical hits land more easily.
Shadow Claw.effect: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.

Thunder Fang.flavorText: The user bites with electrified fangs. It may also make the target flinch or leave it with paralysis.
Thunder Fang.effect: Has a chance to paralyze the target and a chance to make the target flinch.

Ice Fang.flavorText: The user bites with cold-infused fangs. It may also make the target flinch or leave it frozen.
Ice Fang.effect: Has a chance to freeze the target and a chance to make the target flinch.

Fire Fang.flavorText: The user bites with flame-cloaked fangs. It may also make the target flinch or leave it burned.
Fire Fang.effect: Has a chance to burn the target and a chance to make the target flinch.

Shadow Sneak.flavorText: The user extends its shadow and attacks the target from behind. This move always goes first.
Shadow Sneak.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

Mud Bomb.flavorText: The user launches a hard-packed mud ball to attack. It may also lower the target’s accuracy.
Mud Bomb.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s accuracy by one stage.

Psycho Cut.flavorText: The user tears at the target with blades formed by psychic power. Critical hits land more easily.
Psycho Cut.effect: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.

Zen Headbutt.flavorText: The user focuses its willpower to its head and attacks the target. It may also make the target flinch.
Zen Headbutt.effect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.

Mirror Shot.flavorText: The user looses a flash of energy at the target from its polished body. It may also lower the target’s accuracy.
Mirror Shot.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s accuracy by one stage.

Flash Cannon.flavorText: The user gathers all its light energy and releases it at once. It may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.
Flash Cannon.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.

Rock Climb.flavorText: The user attacks the target by smashing into it with incredible force. It may also confuse the target.
Rock Climb.effect: Has a chance to confuse the target.

Defog.flavorText: A strong wind blows away the target’s obstacles such as Reflect or Light Screen. It also lowers the target’s evasiveness.
Defog.effect: Lowers the target’s evasion by one stage. Removes field effects from the enemy field.

Trick Room.flavorText: The user creates a bizarre area in which slower Pokémon get to move first for five turns.
Trick Room.effect: For five turns, slower Pokémon will act before faster Pokémon.

Draco Meteor.flavorText: Comets are summoned down from the sky onto the target. The attack’s recoil harshly reduces the user’s Sp. Atk stat.
Draco Meteor.effect: Lowers the user’s Special Attack by two stages after inflicting damage.

Discharge.flavorText: A flare of electricity is loosed to strike the area around the user. It may also cause paralysis.
Discharge.effect: Has a chance to paralyze the target.

Lava Plume.flavorText: An inferno of scarlet flames torches everything around the user. It may leave targets with a burn.
Lava Plume.effect: Has a chance to burn the target.

Leaf Storm.flavorText: The user whips up a storm of leaves around the target. The attack’s recoil harshly reduces the user’s Sp. Atk stat.
Leaf Storm.effect: Lowers the user’s Special Attack by two stages after inflicting damage.

Power Whip.flavorText: The user violently whirls its vines or tentacles to harshly lash the target.
Power Whip.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

Rock Wrecker.flavorText: The user launches a huge boulder at the target to attack. It must rest on the next turn, however.
Rock Wrecker.effect: User foregoes its next turn to recharge.

Cross Poison.flavorText: A slashing attack with a poisonous blade that may also leave the target poisoned. Critical hits land more easily.
Cross Poison.effect: Has an increased chance for a critical hit and a chance to poison the target.

Gunk Shot.flavorText: The user shoots filthy garbage at the target to attack. It may also poison the target.
Gunk Shot.effect: Has a chance to poison the target.

Iron Head.flavorText: The user slams the target with its steel-hard head. It may also make the target flinch.
Iron Head.effect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.

Magnet Bomb.flavorText: The user launches steel bombs that stick to the target. This attack will not miss.

Stone Edge.flavorText: The user stabs the foe with sharpened stones from below. It has a high critical-hit ratio.
Stone Edge.effect: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.

Captivate.flavorText: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the target is charmed into harshly lowering its Sp. Atk stat.
Captivate.effect: Lowers the target’s Special Attack by two stages if it’s the opposite gender.

Stealth Rock.flavorText: The user lays a trap of levitating stones around the opponent’s team. The trap hurts opponents that switch into battle.
Stealth Rock.effect: Causes damage when opposing Pokémon switch in.

Grass Knot.flavorText: The user snares the target with grass and trips it. The heavier the target, the greater the damage.
Grass Knot.effect: Inflicts more damage to heavier targets, with a maximum of 120 power.

Chatter.flavorText: The user attacks using a sound wave based on words it has learned. It may also confuse the target.
Chatter.effect: Has a higher chance to confuse the target when the recorded sound is louder.
