Judgment.flavorText: The user releases countless shots of light at the target. Its type varies with the kind of Plate the user is holding.
Judgment.effect: If the user is holding a appropriate plate or drive, the damage inflicted will match it.

Bug Bite.flavorText: The user bites the target. If the target is holding a Berry, the user eats it and gains its effect.
Bug Bite.effect: If target has a berry, inflicts double damage and uses the berry.

Charge Beam.flavorText: The user attacks with an electric charge. The user may use any remaining electricity to raise its Sp. Atk stat.
Charge Beam.effect: Has a chance to raise the user’s Special Attack by one stage.

Wood Hammer.flavorText: The user slams its rugged body into the target to attack. The user also sustains serious damage.
Wood Hammer.effect: User receives 1/3 the damage inflicted in recoil.

Aqua Jet.flavorText: The user lunges at the target at a speed that makes it almost invisible. It is sure to strike first.
Aqua Jet.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

Attack Order.flavorText: The user calls out its underlings to pummel the target. Critical hits land more easily.
Attack Order.effect: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.

Defend Order.flavorText: The user calls out its underlings to shield its body, raising its Defense and Sp. Def stats.
Defend Order.effect: Raises the user’s Defense and Special Defense by one stage.

Heal Order.flavorText: The user calls out its underlings to heal it. The user regains up to half of its max HP.
Heal Order.effect: Heals the user by half its max HP.

Head Smash.flavorText: The user attacks the target with a hazardous, full-power headbutt. The user also takes terrible damage.
Head Smash.effect: User receives 1/2 the damage inflicted in recoil.

Double Hit.flavorText: The user slams the target with a long tail, vines, or tentacle. The target is hit twice in a row.

Roar of Time.flavorText: The user blasts the target with power that distorts even time. The user must rest on the next turn.
Roar of Time.effect: User foregoes its next turn to recharge.

Spacial Rend.flavorText: The user tears the target along with the space around it. Critical hits land more easily.
Spacial Rend.effect: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.

Lunar Dance.flavorText: The user faints. In return, the Pokémon taking its place will have its status and HP fully restored.
Lunar Dance.effect: User faints, and its replacement is fully healed.

Crush Grip.flavorText: The target is crushed with great force. The attack is more powerful the more HP the target has left.
Crush Grip.effect: Power increases against targets with more HP remaining, up to a maximum of 121 power.

Magma Storm.flavorText: The target becomes trapped within a maelstrom of fire that rages for four to five turns.
Magma Storm.effect: Prevents the target from fleeing and inflicts damage for 2-5 turns.

Dark Void.flavorText: Opposing Pokémon are dragged into a world of total darkness that makes them sleep.

Seed Flare.flavorText: The user emits a shock wave from its body to attack its target. It may harshly lower the target’s Sp. Def.
Seed Flare.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by two stages.

Ominous Wind.flavorText: The user blasts the target with a gust of repulsive wind. It may also raise all the user’s stats at once.
Ominous Wind.effect: Has a chance to raise all of the user’s stats by one stage.

Shadow Force.flavorText: The user disappears, then strikes the target on the second turn. It hits even if the target protects itself.
Shadow Force.effect: User vanishes, dodging all attacks, and hits next turn. Hits through Protect and Detect.

Hone Claws.flavorText: The user sharpens its claws to boost its Attack stat and accuracy.
Hone Claws.effect: Raises the user’s Attack and accuracy by one stage.

Wide Guard.flavorText: The user and its allies are protected from wide-ranging attacks for one turn. If used in succession, its chance of failing rises.
Wide Guard.effect: Prevents any multi-target moves from hitting friendly Pokémon this turn.

Guard Split.flavorText: The user employs its psychic power to average its Defense and Sp. Def stats with those of its target’s.
Guard Split.effect: Averages Defense and Special Defense with the target.

Power Split.flavorText: The user employs its psychic power to average its Attack and Sp. Atk stats with those of the target’s.
Power Split.effect: Averages Attack and Special Attack with the target.

Wonder Room.flavorText: The user creates a bizarre area in which Pokémon’s Defense and Sp. Def stats are swapped for five turns.
Wonder Room.effect: All Pokémon’s Defense and Special Defense are swapped for 5 turns.

Psyshock.flavorText: The user materializes an odd psychic wave to attack the target. This attack does physical damage.
Psyshock.effect: Inflicts damage based on the target’s Defense, not Special Defense.

Venoshock.flavorText: The user drenches the target in a special poisonous liquid. Its power is doubled if the target is poisoned.
Venoshock.effect: Inflicts double damage if the target is Poisoned.

Autotomize.flavorText: The user sheds part of its body to make itself lighter and sharply raise its Speed stat.
Autotomize.effect: Raises the user’s Speed by two stages and halves the user’s weight.

Rage Powder.flavorText: The user scatters a cloud of irritating powder to draw attention to itself. Opponents aim only at the user.
Rage Powder.effect: Redirects the target’s single-target effects to the user for this turn.

Telekinesis.flavorText: The user makes the target float with its psychic power. The target is easier to hit for three turns.
Telekinesis.effect: Moves have 100% accuracy against the target for three turns.

Magic Room.flavorText: The user creates a bizarre area in which Pokémon’s held items lose their effects for five turns.
Magic Room.effect: Negates held items for five turns.

Smack Down.flavorText: The user throws a stone or projectile to attack an opponent. A flying Pokémon will fall to the ground when hit.
Smack Down.effect: Removes any immunity to Ground damage.

Storm Throw.flavorText: The user strikes the target with a fierce blow. This attack always results in a critical hit.

Flame Burst.flavorText: The user attacks the target with a bursting flame. The bursting flame damages Pokémon next to the target as well.
Flame Burst.effect: Deals splash damage to Pokémon next to the target.

Sludge Wave.flavorText: It swamps the area around the user with a giant sludge wave. It may also poison those hit.
Sludge Wave.effect: Has a chance to poison the target.

Quiver Dance.flavorText: The user lightly performs a beautiful, mystic dance. It boosts the user’s Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, and Speed stats.
Quiver Dance.effect: Raises the user’s Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by one stage each.

Heavy Slam.flavorText: The user slams into the target with its heavy body. The more the user outweighs the target, the greater its damage.
Heavy Slam.effect: Power is higher when the user weighs more than the target, up to a maximum of 120.

Synchronoise.flavorText: Using an odd shock wave, the user inflicts damage on any Pokémon of the same type in the area around it.
Synchronoise.effect: Hits any Pokémon that shares a type with the user.

Electro Ball.flavorText: The user hurls an electric orb at the target. The faster the user is than the target, the greater the damage.
Electro Ball.effect: Power is higher when the user has greater Speed than the target, up to a maximum of 150.

Soak.flavorText: The user shoots a torrent of water at the target and changes the target’s type to Water.
Soak.effect: Changes the target’s type to Water.

Flame Charge.flavorText: The user cloaks itself with flame and attacks. Building up more power, it raises the user’s Speed stat.
Flame Charge.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Raises the user’s Speed by one stage.

Coil.flavorText: The user coils up and concentrates. This raises its Attack and Defense stats as well as its accuracy.
Coil.effect: Raises the user’s Attack, Defense, and accuracy by one stage each.

Low Sweep.flavorText: The user attacks the target’s legs swiftly, reducing the target’s Speed stat.
Low Sweep.effect: Lowers the target’s Speed by one stage.

Acid Spray.flavorText: The user spits fluid that works to melt the target. This harshly reduces the target’s Sp. Def stat.
Acid Spray.effect: Lowers the target’s Special Defense by two stages.

Foul Play.flavorText: The user turns the target’s power against it. The higher the target’s Attack stat, the greater the damage.
Foul Play.effect: Calculates damage with the target’s attacking stat.

Simple Beam.flavorText: The user’s mysterious psychic wave changes the target’s Ability to Simple.
Simple Beam.effect: Changes the target’s ability to Simple.

Entrainment.flavorText: The user dances with an odd rhythm that compels the target to mimic it, making the target’s Ability the same as the user’s.
Entrainment.effect: Copies the user’s ability onto the target.

After You.flavorText: The user helps the target and makes it use its move right after the user.
After You.effect: Makes the target act next this turn.

Round.flavorText: The user attacks the target with a song. Others can join in the Round and make the attack do greater damage.
Round.effect: Has double power if it’s used more than once per turn.

Echoed Voice.flavorText: The user attacks the target with an echoing voice. If this move is used every turn, it does greater damage.
Echoed Voice.effect: Power increases by 100% for each consecutive use by any friendly Pokémon, to a maximum of 200.

Chip Away.flavorText: Looking for an opening, the user strikes continually. The target’s stat changes don’t affect this attack’s damage.

Clear Smog.flavorText: The user attacks by throwing a clump of special mud. All status changes are returned to normal.
Clear Smog.effect: Removes all of the target’s stat modifiers.

Stored Power.flavorText: The user attacks the target with stored power. The more the user’s stats are raised, the greater the damage.
Stored Power.effect: Power is higher the more the user’s stats have been raised, to a maximum of 31×.

Quick Guard.flavorText: The user protects itself and its allies from priority moves. If used in succession, its chance of failing rises.
Quick Guard.effect: Prevents any priority moves from hitting friendly Pokémon this turn.

Ally Switch.flavorText: The user teleports using a strange power and switches its place with one of its allies.
Ally Switch.effect: User switches places with the friendly Pokémon opposite it.

Scald.flavorText: The user shoots boiling hot water at its target. It may also leave the target with a burn.
Scald.effect: Has a chance to burn the target.

Shell Smash.flavorText: The user breaks its shell, lowering its Defense and Sp. Def stats but sharply raising Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats.
Shell Smash.effect: Raises user’s Attack, Special Attack, and Speed by two stages. Lower user’s Defense and Special Defense by one stage.

Heal Pulse.flavorText: The user emits a healing pulse which restores the target’s HP by up to half of its max HP.
Heal Pulse.effect: Heals the target for half its max HP.

Hex.flavorText: This relentless attack does massive damage to a target affected by status problems.
Hex.effect: Has double power if the target has a major status ailment.

Sky Drop.flavorText: The user takes the target into the sky, then drops it during the next turn. The target cannot attack while in the sky.
Sky Drop.effect: Carries the target high into the air, dodging all attacks against either, and drops it next turn.

Shift Gear.flavorText: The user rotates its gears, raising its Attack and sharply raising its Speed.
Shift Gear.effect: Raises the user’s Attack by one stage and its Speed by two stages.

Circle Throw.flavorText: The user throws the target and drags out another Pokémon in its party. In the wild, the battle ends.
Circle Throw.effect: Ends wild battles. Forces trainers to switch Pokémon.

Incinerate.flavorText: The user attacks the target with fire. If the target is holding a Berry, the Berry becomes burnt up and unusable.

Quash.flavorText: The user suppresses the target and makes its move go last.
Quash.effect: Makes the target act last this turn.

Acrobatics.flavorText: The user nimbly strikes the target. If the user is not holding an item, this attack inflicts massive damage.
Acrobatics.effect: Has double power if the user has no held item.

Reflect Type.flavorText: The user reflects the target’s type, making it the same type as the target.

Retaliate.flavorText: The user gets revenge for a fainted ally. If an ally fainted in the previous turn, this attack’s damage increases.
Retaliate.effect: Has double power if a friendly Pokémon fainted last turn.

Final Gambit.flavorText: The user risks everything to attack its target. The user faints but does damage equal to the user’s HP.
Final Gambit.effect: Inflicts damage equal to the user’s remaining HP. User faints.

Bestow.flavorText: The user passes its held item to the target when the target isn’t holding an item.
Bestow.effect: Gives the user’s held item to the target.

Inferno.flavorText: The user attacks by engulfing the target in an intense fire. It leaves the target with a burn.
Inferno.effect: Has a chance to burn the target.

Water Pledge.flavorText: A column of water strikes the target. When combined with its fire equivalent, the damage increases and a rainbow appears.
Water Pledge.effect: With Grass Pledge, halves opposing Pokémon’s Speed for four turns.

Fire Pledge.flavorText: A column of fire hits opposing Pokémon. When used with its Grass equivalent, its damage increases into a vast sea of fire.
Fire Pledge.effect: With Water Pledge, doubles the effect chance of friendly Pokémon’s moves for four turns.

Grass Pledge.flavorText: A column of grass hits opposing Pokémon. When used with its water equivalent, its damage increases into a vast swamp.
Grass Pledge.effect: With Fire Pledge, damages opposing Pokémon for 1/8 their max HP every turn for four turns.

Volt Switch.flavorText: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.
Volt Switch.effect: User must switch out after attacking.

Struggle Bug.flavorText: While resisting, the user attacks the opposing Pokémon. The targets’ Sp. Atk stat is reduced.
Struggle Bug.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Attack by one stage.

Bulldoze.flavorText: The user stomps down on the ground and attacks everything in the area. Hit Pokémon’s Speed stat is reduced.
Bulldoze.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.

Frost Breath.flavorText: The user blows a cold breath on the target. This attack always results in a critical hit.

Dragon Tail.flavorText: The user knocks away the target and drags out another Pokémon in its party. In the wild, the battle ends.
Dragon Tail.effect: Ends wild battles. Forces trainers to switch Pokémon.

Work Up.flavorText: The user is roused, and its Attack and Sp. Atk stats increase.
Work Up.effect: Raises the user’s Attack and Special Attack by one stage each.

Electroweb.flavorText: The user captures and attacks opposing Pokémon by using an electric net. It reduces the targets’ Speed stat.
Electroweb.effect: Lowers the target’s Speed by one stage.

Wild Charge.flavorText: The user shrouds itself in electricity and smashes into its target. It also damages the user a little.
Wild Charge.effect: User receives 1/4 the damage it inflicts in recoil.

Drill Run.flavorText: The user crashes into its target while rotating its body like a drill. Critical hits land more easily.
Drill Run.effect: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.

Dual Chop.flavorText: The user attacks its target by hitting it with brutal strikes. The target is hit twice in a row.

Heart Stamp.flavorText: The user unleashes a vicious blow after its cute act makes the target less wary. It may also make the target flinch.
Heart Stamp.effect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.

Horn Leech.flavorText: The user drains the target’s energy with its horns. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.
Horn Leech.effect: Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.

Sacred Sword.flavorText: The user attacks by slicing with its long horns. The target’s stat changes don’t affect this attack’s damage.

Razor Shell.flavorText: The user cuts its target with sharp shells. This attack may also lower the target’s Defense stat.
Razor Shell.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage.

Heat Crash.flavorText: The user slams its target with its flame- covered body. The more the user outweighs the target, the greater the damage.
Heat Crash.effect: Power is higher when the user weighs more than the target, up to a maximum of 120.

Leaf Tornado.flavorText: The user attacks its target by encircling it in sharp leaves. This attack may also lower the target’s accuracy.
Leaf Tornado.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s accuracy by one stage.

Steamroller.flavorText: The user crushes its targets by rolling over them with its rolled-up body. This attack may make the target flinch.
Steamroller.effect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.

Cotton Guard.flavorText: The user protects itself by wrapping its body in soft cotton, drastically raising the user’s Defense stat.
Cotton Guard.effect: Raises the user’s Defense by three stages.

Night Daze.flavorText: The user lets loose a pitch-black shock wave at its target. It may also lower the target’s accuracy.
Night Daze.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s accuracy by one stage.

Psystrike.flavorText: The user materializes an odd psychic wave to attack the target. This attack does physical damage.
Psystrike.effect: Inflicts damage based on the target’s Defense, not Special Defense.

Tail Slap.flavorText: The user attacks by striking the target with its hard tail. It hits the target two to five times in a row.

Hurricane.flavorText: The user attacks by wrapping its opponent in a fierce wind that flies up into the sky. It may also confuse the target.
Hurricane.effect: Has a chance to confuse the target.

Head Charge.flavorText: The user charges its head into its target, using its powerful guard hair. It also damages the user a little.
Head Charge.effect: User receives 1/4 the damage it inflicts in recoil.

Gear Grind.flavorText: The user attacks by throwing two steel gears at its target.

Searing Shot.flavorText: An inferno of scarlet flames torches everything around the user. It may leave targets with a burn.
Searing Shot.effect: Has a chance to burn the target.

Techno Blast.flavorText: The user fires a beam of light at its target. The type changes depending on the Drive the user holds.
Techno Blast.effect: If the user is holding a appropriate plate or drive, the damage inflicted will match it.

Relic Song.flavorText: The user sings an ancient song and attacks by appealing to the hearts of those listening. It may also induce sleep.
Relic Song.effect: Has a chance to put the target to sleep.

Secret Sword.flavorText: The user cuts with its long horn. The odd power contained in the horn does physical damage to the target.
Secret Sword.effect: Inflicts damage based on the target’s Defense, not Special Defense.

Glaciate.flavorText: The user attacks by blowing freezing cold air at opposing Pokémon. This attack reduces the targets’ Speed stat.
Glaciate.effect: Lowers the target’s Speed by one stage.

Bolt Strike.flavorText: The user charges its target, surrounding itself with a great amount of electricity. It may leave the target with paralysis.
Bolt Strike.effect: Has a chance to paralyze the target.

Blue Flare.flavorText: The user attacks by engulfing the target in an intense, yet beautiful, blue flame. It may leave the target with a burn.
Blue Flare.effect: Has a chance to burn the target.

Fiery Dance.flavorText: Cloaked in flames, the user dances and flaps its wings. It may also raise the user’s Sp. Atk stat.
Fiery Dance.effect: Has a chance to raise the user’s Special Attack by one stage.

Freeze Shock.flavorText: On the second turn, the user hits the target with electrically charged ice. It may leave the target with paralysis.
Freeze Shock.effect: Requires a turn to charge before attacking. Has a chance to paralyze the target.

Ice Burn.flavorText: On the second turn, an ultracold, freezing wind surrounds the target. This may leave the target with a burn.
Ice Burn.effect: Requires a turn to charge before attacking. Has a chance to burn the target.

Snarl.flavorText: The user yells as if it is ranting about something, making the target’s Sp. Atk stat decrease.
Snarl.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Attack by one stage.

Icicle Crash.flavorText: The user attacks by harshly dropping an icicle onto the target. It may also make the target flinch.
Icicle Crash.effect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.

V-create.flavorText: With a hot flame on its forehead, the user hurls itself at its target. It lowers the user’s Defense, Sp. Def, and Speed stats.
V-create.effect: Lowers the user’s Defense, Special Defense, and Speed by one stage each.

Fusion Flare.flavorText: The user brings down a giant flame. This attack does greater damage when influenced by an enormous thunderbolt.
Fusion Flare.effect: With Fusion Bolt, inflicts double damage.

Fusion Bolt.flavorText: The user throws down a giant thunderbolt. This attack does greater damage when influenced by an enormous flame.
Fusion Bolt.effect: With Fusion Flare, inflicts double damage.
